column1: # Burden tier of each test, for the per-disease workup (hoofbeats/workup.py). Hand-made, coarse and ordinal:
# 1 bedside (history, examination, measuring, reviewing images already taken)
# 2 blood/urine/stool tests, ECG, specialist evaluation without a procedure, eye-surface examination
# 3 radiography, ultrasonography, echocardiography, EEG, nerve and muscle studies, function tests
# 4 CT, MRI, nuclear imaging, endoscopy without biopsy, cytogenetic and gene tests
# 5 invasive: biopsy, cerebrospinal fluid, catheter angiography, aspiration, surgery
# It stands in for cost, invasiveness and radiation together. SDBench (Nori et al. 2025) priced tests from a US
# health system's price list; no such list is used here. Change a tier here; workup orders tests by expected weight of evidence / tier.
# pattern: regular expression, case-insensitive, searched in the test name; the first matching row wins.
# kind: exam, lab, imaging, physiology, specialist, invasive, gene, skip (never suggested).
